stemMd: Two fixed point charges are separated by distance r. If separation doubles, what happens to the magnitude of their electrostatic force?
explanationMd: Coulomb force is proportional to 1/r squared. Replacing r by 2r multiplies the denominator by four and reduces force to one quarter.

distractorRationale.d: The force follows an inverse-square law.
distractorRationale.e: Separation is part of Coulomb's law.
